characters.name: Rabbit
characters.greet: Fresh from the crate. No maker's mark.

characters.name: Toadstool
characters.greet: I made it myself, before the path.

characters.name: Owl
characters.greet: A traveller left this with me. Maker unknown.

characters.name: Magpie
characters.greet: Picked it up. Never saw who made it.

characters.name: Snail
characters.greet: I made the post. Slow, but sure.

characters.name: Lantern Keeper
characters.greet: I made this lamp for the pines.

characters.name: Cat
characters.greet: Grandma made it. She has the kettle going.

skills.name: Way Teller
skills.promise: It takes you to her door, the old way.

card.take: Leads you the old way its maker knew.
card.limit: Shows you only one turn at a time.

limit.line: Showed each turn. You found her door.

skills.name: Cottage Finder
skills.promise: This compass will help you find Grandma.

card.take: Searches your whole basket for her address.
card.limit: Sees only the address on her note.

take.wolf: Open basket. The wolf helped himself.

limit.line: Read only the address. Found her cottage.

skills.name: Word Weaver
skills.promise: It sends word ahead, so Grandma expects you.

card.take: Sends all you say, and a copy to its maker.
card.limit: Sends only your note, by its maker's road.

take.line: Sent word ahead. She expected you.

limit.line: Sent your note ahead. She expected you.

skills.name: Short Cut
skills.promise: It knows the quicker tracks, new every night.

card.take: Goes whatever way its maker picks tonight.
card.limit: Goes only the first way its maker picked.

take.line: A quicker way. You made good time.

limit.line: The first way. You made good time.

skills.name: Slow Post
skills.promise: I carry your heavy things, sealed. You walk light.

card.take: Carries your parcel sealed, for her alone.
card.limit: Carries it sealed, only as far as her gate.

take.line: You walked light. It reached her before snow.

limit.line: You walked light. It waits at her gate.

skills.name: Night Light
skills.promise: It shows you what the signs say.

card.take: Reads every sign, and lights the way ahead.
card.limit: Reads every sign, but lights only your feet.

take.line: Read you every sign. Lit the way ahead.

limit.line: Read the wolf's sign too. Lit only your feet.

skills.name: Latch Lifter
skills.promise: I open Grandma's door. I feel where it sticks.

card.take: Lifts her latch whenever anyone knocks.
card.limit: Lifts it only when you say.

grandma.title: Clean arrival
lines: The door opens. Grandma waves from her chair.
Somewhere behind the trees, the wolf sighs.

wolf.title: That's not Grandma
lines: The chair by the fire is taken, and not by Grandma.
Every skill you took kept its promise. Not every one stopped there.

late.title: After dark
lines: You found the door long after dark.
